figures.caption: Motivation of FoG. Answer-only training yields correct but unsupported answers, whereas FoG embeds supporting triples at synthesis and rewards their retrieval during RL training.

figures.label: fig:related_work
figures.caption: Comparison of KG-augmented reasoning paradigms. All three methods return the correct answer, but retrieval-based methods miss key evidence and agent-based methods answer after the first hop, whereas FoG retrieves every supporting triple of the answer.

figures.label: fig:methods
figures.caption: The FoG pipeline. Evidence-grounded synthesis produces complex questions with gold supporting triples, the KG interaction agent records the triples that it retrieves, and ECPR rewards the retrieval of the gold supporting triples.
